problem.title: Property leads vanish into personal phones
problem.description: Listing enquiries land on WhatsApp and often stop there. When every agent works from their own phone, leads go to the wrong person, get lost, or run cold before anyone follows up.
points: Buyers message agents directly, so leads pile up in personal phones
No shared record of who enquired, about which property, or for what budget
Casual browsers and serious buyers are treated the same, wasting agent time
Viewings and follow-ups depend on memory, so hot leads slip away

items.question: How do property leads get assigned?
items.answer: Enquiries route automatically by location, property type or agent availability, with round-robin assignment so leads are shared fairly and none get lost.

items.question: Can Dealup qualify a buyer's budget and intent?
items.answer: Yes. AI captures budget, area and timeline from the conversation into structured fields, so agents can prioritize serious buyers over early-stage browsers.

items.question: How do viewings get booked?
items.answer: Offer available slots directly in the chat, confirm in conversation, and let Dealup send reminders and handle rescheduling automatically.

items.question: What happens to leads my agents forget to follow up on?
items.answer: Automated reminders keep every engaged lead moving toward a viewing or a clear outcome, so no hot prospect slips away.

items.question: Can I re-engage past buyers?
items.answer: Yes. Segment interested buyers by area, budget and property type, and reach out when matching listings come in.
